$comment: Library catalog (R-LIB-6). The single source of what Jjodel shares, until an administration service replaces this file with the same schema. kind: sealedNotation (case 1, a complete language used through the model editor only) or galleryProject (case 2, a project the user clones and owns). status: planned (decided, not built), available (built, its package under frontend/public), deferred (decided for later). publisher is always jjodel until R-LIB-3 opens the gallery to others. description (optional): the one line the Templates page shows under a galleryProject. Version 2 (R-LIB-9): a galleryProject has a tier (template: a small didactic project teaching one concept, with one hand-written viewpoint; example: a complete case of a whole language), its current version n and its versions, each with file (under frontend/public), published date, sha256 of the file and notes. A published version is never rewritten: a fix is a new version. Its deep link is #/templates/<id>@<n>, or #/templates/<id> for the current version.
